responsibilities.title: Job Responsibilities
items: Operate industrial Print-on-Demand (POD) production equipment.
Monitor machine performance and product quality throughout the production process.
Perform machine setup, operation, and basic maintenance following standard operating procedures.
Report equipment malfunctions or technical issues to supervisors.
Follow production procedures and OSHA workplace safety standards.
Collaborate with team members to ensure production schedules and quality standards are achieved.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
items: Legally authorized to work in the United States.
Vietnamese language skills are preferred.
Ability to work in a manufacturing environment.
Interest in manufacturing and production technology is a plus.
Responsible, detail-oriented, and willing to learn.
Able to work independently as well as in a team environment.

Modern, clean, and safe working environment.
Supportive and professional team.
Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding manufacturing company.
